newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cafe de Coral buys property for HK$138 mln.
newsitem.headline: Cafe de Coral buys property for HK$138 mln.

text.p: Fast food restaurant operator Cafe de Coral Holdings Ltd said on Friday its subsidiary Yumi Yumi Caterers Ltd has agreed to buy a commercial propoerty from an independent third party, Hang Tak Co Ltd, for HK$138 million.

The property located at the basemant and ground floor of Argyle Centre Phase I, Nathan Road, has a total gross floor area of about 13,700 square feet and is currently leased to Weli Co Ltd, a unit of Cafe de Coral, it said in a statement.
Completion of the deal is seen on October 30, 1997.
The condideration will be financed partly from the internal resources of the group and partly by bank borrowings, it added.
